text:
esther wong: quick heads-up — our nightly docs scan flagged ~9 occurrences of deprecated /v1 runtime endpoints in the runtime guide. needs a small sweep before the release. examples are /v1/generate -> /v2/generate. grep I used: ```rg "/v1/runtime" docs/runtime -n``` internal report: https://go/reports/deprec-scan. who can pick this up? prefer runtime owners but volunteers welcome.
docs-bot: automated scan (docs-scan) detected 9 matches across 3 files and opened issue #1234 in the docs tracker.
kris patel: I can take this today. estimate ~40m. will open branch `docs/deprec-runtime-sweep`. :+1:
samir ahmed: thanks kris. do we need http redirects/shortlinks for external snapshots? some customers might still reference the old examples. can you paste the file list so we can judge scope?
esther wong: file list from the scan: docs/runtime/guide.md, docs/runtime/examples.md, docs/api-mapping.md. two files contain inline curl examples referencing /v1. if redirects are needed we should coord with webops.
kris patel: quick local grep I ran: ```docs/runtime/guide.md:124:See old example at /v1/runtime/generate
docs/runtime/examples.md:48:curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
docs/api-mapping.md:7:Legacy v1 endpoint mapping table``` I'll open a PR and add a migration note plus a small compatibility blurb.
marta rivera: @kris when you open the PR can you add label `docs:owner=eng-runtime` and request review from @jin? I can QA after deploy.
jin lee: happy to review. quick question — should we keep both v1 and v2 examples side-by-side to show mapping, or remove v1 and leave a note? leaning toward removing v1 content to avoid copy-paste errors, but keep a short mapping section.
kris patel: good call. I'll remove the long v1 examples, add a tiny compatibility section showing mapping, and mark removed examples with a `Deprecated` badge. PR will be up in ~30m. cc @esther wong
esther wong: perfect, thanks. @docs-bot can you link issue #1234 to the incoming PR and add tag `sweep:deprec`?
docs-bot: done — issue #1234 linked to PR #2345 and tag `sweep:deprec` applied.
marta rivera: I'll do post-merge QA at 14:00 PST. if anyone notices staging permalinks or snippet rendering regressions ping me and I'll prioritize a rollback/patch. :wave:
